name: ApiMan
description: Browse Protobuf and debug gRPC / HTTP / SSE / WebSocket APIs inside DBX. Requires Node.js >= 18 on PATH (Go launcher runs runtime/sidecar.js via node; host.binary).
releaseNotes: v0.1.1: publisher zhhoceanfly; host.binary; requires Node.js >= 18 on PATH; LICENSE + THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for runtime/node_modules (@grpc/grpc-js Apache-2.0, @grpc/proto-loader Apache-2.0, protobufjs BSD-3-Clause). Sidecar fails with an actionable message if Node is missing or too old. Clean rebuild (vcs.modified=false); runGhz/openEditor use execFile without shell.
